checks: CDP touch body drag moves without scrolling page or hiding controls
Touch cancellation, capture loss, and viewport interruption leave a usable card
Touch tap crops/reveals; left-corner touch resize preserves opposite edge
Touch seeking changes audio time without moving the card
Touch swipe outside card scrolls page normally
Settings and navigation Escape restore focus independently
320px viewport and maximum lyric size fit within the resized card
Blocked audio gives visible error; explicit retry succeeds; Close pauses
iPhone WebKit emulation: actual emulated touch taps start, crop, reveal and pause
limitations: Engine emulation on macOS, not physical Android/iPhone hardware. WebKit touch swipes and continuous touch drags unavailable in the public Playwright API; Chrome CDP touch drag/swipe tested.
